roads.name: West Branch Road
words: Properly twisty: 28 curves in 3.8 miles, about 8 a mile.
From 1,468 to 1,522 ft, with 308 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
Water alongside for stretches.
July highs average 77°F.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.04 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.
